name: Build APK

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.24.0'
          channel: 'stable'

      - name: Scaffold the platform-specific project files
        run: |
          # Our repo only contains pubspec.yaml + lib/ (the Dart source).
          # `flutter create` generates the android/, ios/, etc. folders
          # that Gradle needs to actually build an APK. We generate a
          # fresh scaffold in a temp directory, then drop our own
          # pubspec.yaml and lib/ into it before building.
          flutter create --org org.bobur --project-name luna_chess /tmp/scaffold
          cp -f pubspec.yaml /tmp/scaffold/pubspec.yaml
          rm -rf /tmp/scaffold/lib
          cp -r lib /tmp/scaffold/lib
          if [ -d assets ]; then cp -r assets /tmp/scaffold/assets; fi
          # flutter_tts requires minSdk 24; the fresh scaffold defaults to
          # flutter.minSdkVersion (21), so bump it here. Handle both the
          # Groovy (build.gradle) and Kotlin DSL (build.gradle.kts) cases,
          # whichever this Flutter version actually generated.
          GRADLE_FILE=""
          if [ -f /tmp/scaffold/android/app/build.gradle.kts ]; then
            GRADLE_FILE=/tmp/scaffold/android/app/build.gradle.kts
          elif [ -f /tmp/scaffold/android/app/build.gradle ]; then
            GRADLE_FILE=/tmp/scaffold/android/app/build.gradle
          fi
          echo "Using gradle file: $GRADLE_FILE"
          if [ -n "$GRADLE_FILE" ]; then
            sed -i \
              -e 's/minSdk = flutter.minSdkVersion/minSdk = 24/' \
              -e 's/minSdkVersion flutter.minSdkVersion/minSdkVersion 24/' \
              -e 's/minSdkVersion = flutter.minSdkVersion/minSdkVersion = 24/' \
              "$GRADLE_FILE"
            grep -n "minSdk" "$GRADLE_FILE"
          else
            echo "::error::No build.gradle or build.gradle.kts found under /tmp/scaffold/android/app"
            exit 1
          fi
          # flutter_tts (4.2.5) is compiled with a newer Kotlin (2.2.0) than
          # the scaffold's default Kotlin Gradle plugin (1.7.1), causing a
          # metadata-version mismatch at compile time. Bump the Kotlin
          # plugin version wherever it's declared (settings.gradle in
          # newer scaffolds, build.gradle's ext.kotlin_version in older ones).
          for f in /tmp/scaffold/android/settings.gradle /tmp/scaffold/android/settings.gradle.kts; do
            if [ -f "$f" ]; then
              sed -i -E "s/(org\.jetbrains\.kotlin\.android[\"']? version [\"'])[0-9.]+([\"'])/\12.1.0\2/" "$f"
              grep -n "kotlin.android" "$f" || true
            fi
          done
          if [ -f /tmp/scaffold/android/build.gradle ]; then
            sed -i -E "s/ext\.kotlin_version = ['\"][0-9.]+['\"]/ext.kotlin_version = '2.1.0'/" /tmp/scaffold/android/build.gradle
            grep -n "kotlin_version" /tmp/scaffold/android/build.gradle || true
          fi

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: /tmp/scaffold
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Build APK
        working-directory: /tmp/scaffold
        run: flutter build apk --debug

      - name: Upload APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: luna-chess-flutter-apk
          path: /tmp/scaffold/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk
